title: Evidence Trace: your AI asks, you inspect

scenes.title: Two evidence tiers, honestly labelled
cues: Evidence Trace puts evidence before answers.
This is an independent prototype, not a government service.
Eighty reviewed records retain item-level evidence receipts.
Another 58,652 records support wider governed discovery.
They come from 58,655 locked source rows.
Three standalone legislation rows remain quarantined.

scenes.title: Search governed OKF snapshots together
cues: A person can search four governed OKF sources together.
They cover UK Living, ONS and the government API catalogue.
They also include metadata-only HM Land Registry discovery.
The fixed housing search returns every selected source.
Its ordering shows bounded relevance, not a trust score.

scenes.title: Keep origin, link role and limitations visible
cues: This result keeps its collection and checksum-bound snapshot visible.
Its source link has the producer-declared-source role.
The destination hostname and limitations remain inspectable.
Source authority is not independently established.
This wider tier does not claim an item-level receipt.

scenes.title: Five bounded tools over the same evidence
cues: This reconstruction names the host, version and observation time.
Its receipt records all five native page tools and their schemas.
Search uses the same housing query and four collections.
Record and provenance calls use the bound federated result.
Reviewed tools explore and compare separate evidence facets.
The page accepts no personal context field or hosted model.

scenes.title: Inspect facets without inventing a trust score
cues: Reviewed evidence supports a deeper, receipt-bound view.
People and agents can inspect one answer foundation.
They can compare authority, freshness, integrity and rights.
Access and coverage remain separate as well.
No combined score hides uncertainty or declares a winner.

scenes.title: Follow the same evidence with VoiceOver
cues: A fresh manual Safari and VoiceOver journey checks this release.
It follows headings, controls, search and the selected record.
It checks the source-link role, destination and authority label.
It also covers comparison, live status and focus restoration.
This bounded observation is not a WCAG conformance claim.

scenes.title: Publish inspectable tools, not another chatbot
cues: The page hosts no model and exposes no profile or conversation-history field.
A citizen-selected AI can send only the necessary declared arguments.
A remote provider may still receive the prompt, arguments and result.
This static path calls neither official APIs nor a model at runtime.
Land Registry remains metadata-only, with no personal rows.
No standalone legislation payload, index or result link is published.
Privacy, cost and accuracy benefits remain hypotheses to test.
Your AI asks. You inspect the evidence.
